limits: Real built loopback Host/World, paused isolated Run, production workers/viewports; no production instrumentation or model changes.

Dispatch and milestones use World performance.now. Exact prepared typed-array -> VBO/VAO -> requested semantic view draw is observed, then a microtask fence includes Plan composition. GPU completion is not a physical-monitor presentation timestamp.
Prepared response includes queue/worker/transfer; no controller-ready timestamp is claimed without a product hook. First matching draw proves admission occurred by that point.

WeakMap tags and primitive-only logs do not retain prepared arrays across forced GC. Instrumentation adds overhead; draw-wrapper diagnostic cost is reported separately and does not include every wrapper.
No fixed settlement sleeps. Initial controls mount is separate from layout completion. One GPU/profile/device and local services; full-product and isolated-engine timings are not interchangeable.
